title: UDLF deployment config — Microsoft Defender XDR custom detection rules
description: Config for `platform: defender-xdr`. Defender XDR custom detection rules (Microsoft Graph beta `/security/rules/detectionRules`, post-2026-06 shape): schedule, alert template, entity mappings, automated response actions and device-group scope. Written from the Graph resource pages, not the portal. The same JSON serialises to the `Microsoft.Security/detectionRules` Bicep resource. Query lives in `detection_content` (`kql`, advanced-hunting schema).
$comment: Supersedes `defender-for-endpoint/v0.1.0`, which mirrors the legacy Graph shape (`isEnabled`, `period`, `alertTemplate.category`, `impactedAssets`, `responseActions`, `scopeType`/`scopeNames`) that Microsoft removes on 2026-10-01. Closed at every level; no root `required` because a partially-authored block is legitimate and the deployer fills Graph's required fields from the detection. The rule `id` is derived by the deployer and not carried.

duration.description: A duration in either the shorthand engineers type (`1h`, `24h`) or the ISO 8601 form the API returns (`PT1H`, `P1D`). Shape only; bounds are stated per field and enforced by the deployer.

column.description: A column of the detection query's result set.

column_map.description: One entity or action target, as the `*Column` fields Graph defines for it, spelled snake_case (`device_id_column` ↔ `deviceIdColumn`, `sha256_column` ↔ `sha256Column`). Each value names the query column that supplies it. The set of valid keys is the Graph mapping type's own and is not enumerated here, so a new column Microsoft adds needs no schema bump.

account_map.description: One account, as Graph's `accountEntityMapping` columns. Graph rejects an account without a unique id (`aad_user_id_column`, `sid_column`, `upn_column`) or a name paired with a domain (`nt_domain_column`, `dns_domain_column`, `upn_suffix_column`).

device_actions.description: Devices to act on, each identified by a device-id column. Maps to a `deviceAction` collection.

schema.description: Sub-schema revision this block was authored against, e.g. `defender-xdr::0.1.0`.

severity.description: Severity for this deployment. Optional, overrides `detection_context.severity`. Defender's own four values: it has no `critical`, and a UDLF `critical` on the detection renders as `high`. Maps to `detectionAction.alertTemplate.severity`.

schedule.description: How often the rule runs. Maps to `schedule.frequency`. Defender couples frequency to lookback for its own tables (24h looks back 30 days, 12h/48h, 3h/12h, 1h/4h), so there is no lookback field; a rule over Sentinel analytics-tier tables in a Defender-onboarded workspace may use 5 minutes to 14 days.

allOf.$comment: Near-real-time rules run continuously as events arrive, so a frequency is meaningless. Eligibility is strict (single table, an operator allow-list, no joins or comments) and is checked by the deployer at plan time.

frequency.description: The recurring interval the rule runs at. Defender data allows `1h`, `3h`, `12h`, `24h`; Sentinel-only data allows 5 minutes to 14 days.

nrt.description: Run continuously as events arrive rather than on an interval.

alert.description: The alert a match raises. Maps to `detectionAction.alertTemplate`. A custom detection always alerts; there is no non-alerting state.

title.description: Alert title, at most 3 `{{Column}}` tokens. Overrides the detection title for this deployment; Graph requires it, so the deployer falls back to the title. Maps to `alertTemplate.title`.

description.description: Alert description for analysts, at most 3 `{{Column}}` tokens. Overrides `detection_context.description`. Maps to `alertTemplate.description`.

recommended_actions.description: Recommended response steps shown with the alert, at most 3 `{{Column}}` tokens. Maps to `alertTemplate.recommendedActions`.

tactics.description: ATT&CK framing **as an override** of what the deployer derives from `threat.attack[]`. Defender nests techniques under tactics, so set this only when the file's `threat` block cannot say what you mean. Maps to `alertTemplate.tactics`.

tactic.description: The tactic as Defender spells it.

technique.description: An ATT&CK technique or sub-technique id.

sub_techniques.description: Sub-technique ids listed under the technique.

custom_details.description: Custom key/value details on the alert, each value naming the query column that supplies it. At most 20, 4 KB in total. Maps to `alertTemplate.customDetails`.

entities.description: How query columns become the entities attached to the alert, grouped by entity kind. Each kind's items carry that Graph mapping type's `*Column` fields. Maps to `alertTemplate.entityMappings`. Defender requires the columns an entity kind names to exist in the query result (`DeviceId`/`DeviceName` for hosts, `Timestamp` and `ReportId` always).

actions.description: Automated response actions run against the entities a match identifies. These change endpoint, file, identity and mailbox state — an isolate-device action fires up to 150 times per run — so a deployer must show them as a distinct section of any plan a human approves. Maps to `detectionAction.automatedActions`.

isolation_type.description: `full` cuts off every application and service; `selective` leaves a limited set reachable.

allow_files.description: Allow files identified by hash columns. Maps to `allowFiles` (`fileAction`).

block_files.description: Block files identified by hash columns. Maps to `blockFiles` (`fileAction`).

stop_and_quarantine_files.description: Stop running files and quarantine them on the identified devices. Maps to `stopAndQuarantineFiles`.

mark_users_as_compromised.description: Raise the Entra risk level of users identified by object-id columns. Maps to `markUsersAsCompromised` (`accountObjectIdAction`).

disable_users.description: Disable users identified by SID columns. Maps to `disableUsers` (`accountSidAction`).

force_user_password_resets.description: Force a password reset for users identified by SID columns. Maps to `forceUserPasswordResets` (`accountSidAction`).

hard_delete_emails.description: Permanently delete the identified messages. Maps to `hardDeleteEmails` (`emailAction`).

scope.description: Which device groups the rule runs against. Omit to run against every device. Maps to `detectionAction.organizationalScope.deviceGroups`.

device_groups.description: Named device groups the rule is scoped to.

exclusions.description: Tuning exclusions appended to the deployed query in order, each with a reason.

reason.description: Why this exclusion exists. Required so tuning decisions stay auditable.

let.description: KQL `let` bindings emitted before the exclusion query and referenceable from it. Values are inserted verbatim.

query.description: KQL appended to the base query.

advanced.description: Escape hatch for unmodelled Graph `detectionRule` properties. Passed through verbatim and unvalidated; prefer a modelled field.
